title: Told Out of Season
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 137
medium: Interactive page (index.html): the one picture eighteen makers were given; their eighteen still works in three columns by what they were told (a false January–March span, a false October–December span, nothing), each with its maker's favoured view of what was measured; a reveal of the true record and its dates against the two told spans; the two rows' outcomes. A figure (figure.svg); scoring (score.py), face data (facedata.py), maker and coder evidence.
embodies: A told date that cannot be checked rewrites what the maker sees rather than being doubted. Told nothing, five of six makers read a glacier-fed stream, which it is. Told a false winter date, five of six turned it into a heater switched off for spring; told a false autumn date, five of six into a sun-driven temperature going into winter. No maker said a date did not fit.
project_step: Twenty-fifth experiment of the project. Operation: judging (perceiving, finding a form). It is the event of rows S135.DEFAULT (falsified) and S136.RESCUE (held), the second written from the knowledge-conflict literature on a reading night (Session 136). Takes from experiment 24 its grain F, render, brief and coder H's standing and derivation code, with fit, hemisphere and premises added; adds an untold cell to measure the default on a new kind. Works with Cartography, not Tracing: the untold makers mapped the material and found its kind, the told makers traced a calendar onto it and re-read the shape to fit.
material: US Geological Survey, NWIS instantaneous values, site 06221400 Dinwoody Creek above lakes near Burris, Wyoming, parameter 00060 (discharge, ft³/s), 15-minute values averaged into 1,464 hours of local standard time (UTC−7), 2025-08-01 00:00 to 2025-09-30 23:00; 618 values approved, 5,239 provisional. Fetched 2026-10-19. US public domain. Domain: glacier runoff (glaciology).
seed: prepare.py seed 137 (cells); makers and coder are model instances and not seeded
